title: zygophyllum indicum
intro: Zygophyllum indicum, commonly known as Caltrop or Indian Fig, is a desert shrub native to the Indian subcontinent. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Zygophyllum indicum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and reduce the risk of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
